indications.indication: Lumbar spinal fusion in degenerative disc disease (transforaminal lumbar interbody fusion, TLIF)
indications.highest_phase: Pilot / first-in-human (device feasibility; pre-IDE; analogous to Phase 1)
indications.trial_name: First-in-Man Pilot Clinical Study of NB1 (NELL-1/DBM) in TLIF
indications.trial_design: Multicenter, prospective, randomized pilot study; up to 30 adult subjects with single-level DDD (L2-S1); primary endpoint fusion success at 12 months plus change in Oswestry Disability Index
indications.trial_status: Active, recruiting (first subjects treated 2024) — registered on ANZCTR (Australia) under ACTRN12623000581662; not on ClinicalTrials.gov
key_milestones: TGA and HREC approval to commence pilot study in Australia
